big_case.notes: Individual Section 1983 damages action against a municipal police officer resolved below by a nonprecedential Third Circuit qualified-immunity affirmance and disposed of at the Supreme Court by a routine first-conference cert denial with waived opposition and no separate writing. While the petition framed a recurring methodological question on whether Rochin/Lewis conscience-shocking executive-misconduct claims require a Glucksberg fundamental liberty interest and drew one law-professor amicus brief, no statute or broad government program was at stake and the case ended without merits review.
